cover.prompt: In front, arche-accountant sits on the low stone retaining wall before House 1's portico, writing a rising number on a narrow papyrus slip beside a hemispherical stone sundial which casts no shadow under the heavy grey overcast sky; arche-messenger jogs along the dirt ring road in front of the portico.
cover.others: two more messengers dressed identically (bare-headed, undyed wool exomis, drawstring hide sack), jogging in single file behind the first along the road, spaced apart, going the same way, each with a natural individual build and stride.

r.prompt: arche-accountant sits on the rock in the foreground reading a scroll. arche-clerk and arche-messenger are in the building portico arguing about something.

g1.prompt: Outside House 1 on the ring road, arche-accountant stands beside a hemispherical stone sundial, inking a rising sequential timestamp onto a narrow papyrus slip with deliberate precision, his arm and quill held prominently clear of his torso; arche-messenger in undyed exomis sprints past along the dirt road in an expansive wide contact stride, satchel strap across his chest, left arm swinging forward; the stone stylobate corner of House 1 forms a crisp foreground anchor on the left margin; the stone facade angles diagonally at 35 degrees into the scene, with the long sweep of the coastal road and mountain foothills defined sharply under warm golden sunlight.
g1.others: arche-clerk reading the board of requests in the porch.

t01-gate.prompt: Before House 3's portico, arche-messenger and a second messenger arrive at the same instant from opposite ends of the road before the colonnade, each holding out one narrow papyrus slip toward the gateway passage under the slotted wooden request board mounted on the wall; a loader leans in the doorway.
t01-gate.others: a second messenger dressed identically (short undyed wool exomis, drawstring sack), reaching the gate from the opposite side at the same instant, and a storehouse loader in an undyed tunic leaning in the open doorway.

t03-slip.prompt: Standing on the stone-paved stylobate before House 1's portico under low overcast sky, arche-accountant hands a narrow papyrus slip with the logical tally inked on it to arche-messenger, who reaches to take it and slip it into his pouch; the slotted request board and stone bench are visible on the wall behind them.
